payout_quote: eligible to receive the $100 CollegeBoundbaby Grant
steps: Check the CollegeBoundbaby box on the hospital birth worksheet, OR self-enroll by submitting the CollegeBoundbaby Authorization Form within one year of the child's birth or adoption.
The $100 grant is deposited into the child's CollegeBound account.
When the child enrolls in college, funds are disbursed by the RI Treasurer directly to the eligible school.
catches: Rhode Island birth or adoption only, and enrollment must happen before the child's first birthday or within the first year of adoption - miss the window and there is no grant.
The grant, including any earnings on it, cannot be transferred to another child, withdrawn for a non-education purpose, or moved to another 529 plan.
Grant funds are disbursed directly to the eligible college or trade/vocational school, not to you.
Non-qualified withdrawals face federal income tax on earnings plus a 10% federal penalty - consult a tax advisor.
biggest_catch: One-shot $100 grant with a hard one-year enrollment window - and the money can only ever go straight to an eligible school for qualified expenses.
eligibility: Children born to or adopted by Rhode Island families, enrolled before the child's first birthday or within one year of adoption.
timing: One-time: enroll within one year of birth or adoption; the $100 grant is deposited to the CollegeBound account.
payout_value_note: Flat $100 state grant per eligible child; no contribution required.
numeric_basis: payout from official RI terms ($100 flat grant); time: birth-worksheet checkbox or self-enrollment form, est. 10-20 min active.
